annotations.title: Check: analyse a wallet with a credit

description: Spends ONE paid credit on ONE wallet: the free screening (OFAC SDN, issuer freeze) and both paid tools (Scorechain, Merkle Science through Didit). chainId is the network of the wallet to analyse (one of check_info networks); it need not be the network or the family that paid. Returns check with status used, target, seal (red: risk found, sanction, issuer freeze or a blocking Merkle score; yellow: medium risk; green: no risk, Merkle no_data included; grey: a paid reading did not come back), result { verdict, risk, tools [{ tool, result clear|flagged|unavailable, score 0-100, severity, summary, category, factors, sourceOfFunds, destinationOfFunds, analyzedAt, fromHistory }], details }, screening (the full reading) and events (the real steps, with ms). Only this payer can read it. The same credit and the same wallet again answers what is stored, with no provider call; another wallet is check_credit_used (409). Two calls at once run ONE analysis (the other gets check_running, 409). check_unreadable (503): a reading did not answer, the credit is still valid, call again with the same arguments. analysis_tool_unavailable (503): a tool is down and the credit was not touched.

access.description: The Check access of this payer from check_access (vca_...). Secret: it reads and spends this payer's credits.

chainId.description: EVM: integer from GET /v1/chains (1, 10, 56, 100, 137, 8453, 42161, 43114, 130). Solana: string from GET /v1/svm/chains ("solana-mainnet").

checkId.description: A paid check id (check_credits lists them).

payer.description: The wallet that paid this Check.

wallet.description: The wallet to analyse (0x on EVM, base58 on Solana, case-sensitive).

name: check_analyze
